title: The ESXi host Secure Shell (SSH) daemon must ignore ".rhosts" files.
check_content:
From an ESXi shell, run the following command:

# /usr/lib/vmware/openssh/bin/sshd -T|grep ignorerhosts

Expected result:

ignorerhosts yes

If the output does not match the expected result, this is a finding.
fixtext:
From an ESXi shell, add or correct the following line in "/etc/ssh/sshd_config":

IgnoreRhosts yes
VulnDiscussion: SSH trust relationships mean a compromise on one host can allow an attacker to move trivially to other hosts. SSH can emulate the behavior of the obsolete "rsh" command in allowing users to enable insecure access to their accounts via ".rhosts" files.
